Alyssa (Support): Hey billing-team — urgent: customer BrightFork reports invoice INV-2026-0042 missing their PO. They uploaded PO 'BF-PO-783221' in the portal but the invoice Purchase Ref is blank. Customer already paid by card. Need reissue + credit/rebill path, they need a corrected invoice for AP by EOD.

Ming (Billing Ops): Checking. Do we have the PO in invoice metadata or just as an upload? Can you paste the portal webhook payload or order id?

Alyssa (Support): Payload from portal webhook: { "invoice_id":"INV-2026-0042", "purchase_ref": "", "portal_uploads":[{"filename":"BF-PO-783221.pdf","type":"purchase_order"}], "customer_id":"cust_BrightFork" }

Sam (Payments): Payment status = succeeded, settlement_date = 2026-03-10. Once paid we cannot mutate the issued invoice. Standard path: issue credit note for the original invoice, create a corrected invoice with PO, then re-bill the card on file. Alternatively refund to card then re-charge on the new invoice. Which does the customer prefer?

Jordan (Account Manager): Customer wants corrected invoice and prefers credit note + reissue (no refund to card first). They said AP won't accept anything else and need it today.

Priya (Finance): OK. Approve this flow. Steps I need to see: 1) Credit note for INV-2026-0042 for full amount. 2) New invoice INV-2026-0042-R1 with purchase_ref BF-PO-783221. 3) Re-bill using card token. I'll sign off on the credit note.

Ming (Billing Ops): Quick checks: do we have a card token on file and is the invoice in hosted mode?

Sam (Payments): Card token available: card_tok_abc123 (last4 4242). Hosted API billing.

Alyssa (Support): Customer upload timestamp 2026-03-09 16:12 UTC, support ticket #78922. They attached the PDF again in the ticket.

Ming (Billing Ops): I'll run admin actions now. CLI snippet for audit trail:

```bash
# admin steps (internal)
billing-admin credit-note create --invoice INV-2026-0042 --reason "PO missing on issued invoice" --amount 1000.00 --note "Customer provided PO BF-PO-783221"
billing-admin invoice create --customer cust_BrightFork --amount 1000.00 --purchase_ref BF-PO-783221 --reference INV-2026-0042-R1
billing-admin payments charge --invoice INV-2026-0042-R1 --card-token card_tok_abc123 --idempotency-key act_4357
```

Ming (Billing Ops): Ran credit-note create -> CN-2026-009. Created new invoice INV-2026-0042-R1. Initiating charge...

billing-bot: payment.succeeded invoice=INV-2026-0042-R1 amount=1000.00 txn=txn_999888

Jordan (Account Manager): Customer confirmed they received the corrected invoice PDF and that it satisfies AP. Payment processed. Jordan: please send the corrected invoice and CN to their AP contact and close the PO mismatch loop.

Alyssa (Support): Sending AP email now and attaching INV-2026-0042-R1 and CN-2026-009. I'll update ticket #78922 and mark for closure after they confirm receipt. Thanks all :raised_hands:

Priya (Finance): Adding accounting entries and voiding original invoice in ledger. Attaching CN-2026-009 to ledger entry.

Sam (Payments): Note for audit: admin action IDs act_4356 (credit-note) and act_4357 (re-bill charge). Logged txn_999888.

Ming (Billing Ops): Actions complete, updated account notes and internal audit links. Closing thread.
